items.title: Jam update: Fri 12:17 PM
items.content_html:
Jam update: Fri 12:17 PM

Friday, November 13, 2026 at 12:17 PM Central

5 more are in progress. The team pushed 47 project updates across Verse gameplay code, art, props and materials, audio.

In progress

  • EDGE 4: music and stings - generated genre beds first, then the owner's Patchwork reactive pipeline (stems -> MIDI -> Patchwork -> Song Sync -> stage events)
  • All player UI as Widget Blueprints: convert the Verse-built menu and take bar (animations, sounds, IA_ glyphs, mobile + controller)
  • EDGE 2: witness run and fix loop until one plain take is clean (voice path WORKS or HIDDEN)
  • EDGE 3: one-press loop - ACTION / CUT / NEW SHOW on screen, auto-roll, reopenable menu, less dead air (the menu must be fixed)
  • EDGE 6: freeze, capture, declare, dev log (Glass Box), submit by Sunday 17:00 CST

items.title: MegaJam26 begins
items.content_html:
MegaJam26 begins

Thursday, November 12, 2026 at 9:35 AM Central

MegaJam26 is underway. Over the next few days our studio is building a brand-new Fortnite island in UEFN for the GlassDoor MegaJam26 benefit jam, and this devlog follows along from the first blank level to the final build. The jam runs until Sunday, November 15 at 7:59 PM Central. Today was all about getting set up: the team is in place, roles are assigned, the project and our task board are ready, and the first gameplay goals are on the list. Our studio team works alongside AI-assisted production tools, and this log itself is assembled automatically every few hours from our progress, then checked before it goes out. Check back for screenshots, clips and new features as the island comes together.
